blacklistabilityReview.evidence: PLNQ whitepaper D.1 reserves the right to blacklist addresses and freeze PLNQ for illegal activity or terms violations; F.3/F.4 disclose recovery and freezing controls. Whitepaper E.9/E.10 attributes the Ethereum/Polygon ERC-20 implementation audit to ChainSecurity with no known vulnerabilities and states Quantoz has been ISO/IEC 27001 certified since 2020; this is issuer-reported audit evidence, not an independently retrieved report or a verified deployed-bytecode match. Alchemy Ethereum RPC reads re-verified on 2026-10-03 at block 26110052 returned zero totalSupply, EIP-1967 implementation 0x8b98bcd9b1f8ae112fb2b58b45c3bc9a75cc4d0e, admin 0xa6724f792002d5677a7bc370986e1b580b8773e7 and owner() 0x284df7b9d9f471554e9257bd9b116189f7997d45. The owner's getOwners() returned five addresses; getThreshold() returned empty data, so no signature threshold is verified.
